title: FCC Probe May Foil NFL’s Early TV Renewal Talks

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: FCC Probe May Foil NFL’s Early TV Renewal Talks
sources.description: If you’re starting to detect a whiff of nightwatch in the recirculated air swirling around the NFL’s talks with CBS, you’re not alone. The old media world is dying, and while that gloomy vigil bleeds into yet another dark hour, somewhere in the same hospital there’s a new world that’s about to be dragged into …
